member.summary:
Stores metadata for documents/scans attached to a vehicle. The physical file lives on the filesystem under DocumentStorage:BasePath.
Document categories correspond to FIS modules so all documents for a vehicle (accidents, licences, fines, job cards, etc.) can be retrieved under one vehicle file.
